_readme: CLOUD LLM example for recon agents (full agent_config.json shape).
A) CLI switch (recommended — fills base_url/model presets):
python recon_agents.py config set --provider xai --model grok-2-latest
B) Copy this file over the active config:
Then set the API key in the environment (do NOT commit keys):
python recon_agents.py run --target example.com --provider xai --model grok-2-latest
Swap the llm block below for another cloud provider — see
NEVER put real API keys in this file if you commit it to git.
Prefer env vars: XAI_API_KEY, ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, OPENAI_API_KEY, etc.

network.notes: Cloud mode: keys from env (XAI_API_KEY / ANTHROPIC_API_KEY / OPENAI_API_KEY / GOOGLE_API_KEY / OPENROUTER_API_KEY / GROQ_API_KEY). Leave llm.api_key empty. base_url is the provider default — only change for custom gateways.
